description: ocsp.rs line 127: info.revocation_reason.map(|r| r as u8). The revocation_reason field type comes from x509-ocsp/x509-cert; if CrlReason is #[repr(u32)] (as confirmed from crl.rs), then r as u8 silently truncates any value >255. Defined values are 0-10 and all fit in u8, but the cast is semantically unsound for the same reason as in crl.rs. Should use u32 or match explicitly to a u8 with a fallback.
title: OcspChecker reason_code cast: CertStatus::Revoked reason uses r as u8
